global.description: Global values shared between all subcharts and the platform.

allowPrivateIP.description: Deprecated: list the hosts in allowPrivateIPTokenEndpointHosts. Lets every token endpoint resolve to any private, loopback or link-local address and overrides allowPrivateIPTokenEndpointHosts. Implied when extraCaFile is set and no host is listed. Still accepted; logs a startup warning.

allowPrivateIPTokenEndpointHosts.description: Token endpoint hostnames that may resolve to RFC 1918 or RFC 4193 addresses: a remote Dex behind an internal-only load balancer. Loopback and link-local stay refused, and every other host keeps the SSRF guard. Exact match, no port, no wildcard. With extraCaFile the listed hosts also trust that CA; with extraCaFile and no host listed every token endpoint may resolve to any private address (warned). Example: - dex.example.internal

acknowledgeUnauthenticatedExposure.description: Publish muster through ingress or gatewayAPI while enabled is false. Without OAuth every request is served as the synthetic default-user, so the chart refuses to render an Ingress or HTTPRoute unless this is set. Only for a deliberately unauthenticated install behind a trusted proxy that authenticates every request itself.

allowLocalhostRedirectURIs.description: Deprecated, no effect: loopback redirect URIs are always allowed on any port (RFC 8252 §7.3). Accepted so existing values keep rendering; removed in v5.64.0, scheduled for 2027-02-17.

allowPrivateIPClientMetadata.description: Deprecated: pin the clients in preRegisteredClientMetadata. Lets every CIMD client_id URL resolve to a private, loopback or link-local address. Still accepted; logs a startup warning.

allowPrivateIPClientMetadataHosts.description: Deprecated: pin the clients in preRegisteredClientMetadata; a pinned client needs no fetch. Lets the listed CIMD client_id hosts resolve to an RFC 1918 or RFC 4193 address. Still accepted; logs a startup warning.

allowPrivateIPRedirectURIHosts.description: The host-scoped alternative to allowPrivateIPRedirectURIs: a redirect URI may resolve to an RFC 1918 or RFC 4193 address only when its hostname is listed (exact match, no port, no wildcard). allowPrivateIPRedirectURIs overrides it. Default: empty. Example: - agentgateway.internal.example

allowPrivateIPRedirectURIs.description: Deprecated: list the hosts in allowPrivateIPRedirectURIHosts. Lets every redirect URI resolve to a private address and overrides allowPrivateIPRedirectURIHosts. Still accepted; logs a startup warning.

allowedOrigins.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the MCP transports. Same-origin and requests without Origin are allowed. Other Origins log DEPRECATED without changing the response during the overlap. List exact origins with no path; wildcards and null are not allowed.

clientMetadataHosts.description: Hosts whose documents restrictClientMetadata still lets muster fetch, under the SSRF guard (no private-address allowance). Exact hostnames. Requires restrictClientMetadata.

allowPrivateIPJWKS.description: Deprecated: let the JWKS fetch that validates forwarded ID tokens (trustedAudiences) reach any private, loopback or link-local address. Without it the Dex issuer host may still resolve to an RFC 1918 or RFC 4193 address, so remove it unless Dex resolves to loopback or link-local. Logs a startup warning.

allowPrivateIPOIDC.description: Deprecated: the former name of allowPrivateIPJWKS; either true value enables it. Logs a startup warning.

initialAccessToken.description: Shared secret a client must present at the DCR endpoint to register. Supply via existingSecret (key: registration-token) in production so the value never appears in Helm release history.

preRegisterPublicClients.description: Also pin the public clients in publicClientMetadata (claude.ai, Claude Code, VS Code), so muster never fetches their documents. Needed where egress goes through a proxy that allows by domain.

preRegisteredClientMetadata.description: Pinned Client ID Metadata Documents for this installation (CIMD draft 03 section 9.2): a pinned client is served from its document here and never fetched. Use it for a client on a private address (klaus-gateway's agentgateway.<domain>/auth/slack/client.json) or behind an egress proxy that allows by domain. Pin only a document reviewed against its live URL. Each entry is the document with its JSON field names (client_id, redirect_uris, ...).

providerTokenRefreshThreshold.description: How much lifetime the provider (Dex) token muster holds for a user must have left before muster hands it out as is; a token closer to its expiry is refreshed at the provider first. Governs the token forwarded to downstream servers and the one a client's refresh returns. Raise it when a caller needs a forwarded token that outlives a long operation (e.g. "25m" for agent turns of 20 minutes); keep it below the provider's token lifetime (Dex idTokens, 30m by default), or every request refreshes at the provider. Go duration of at least 1s. Empty: the mcp-oauth default of 5m.

publicClientMetadata.description: The public clients' documents, as fetched from their client_id URLs. Pinned only when preRegisterPublicClients is true. Override an entry here if a live document changed before a chart release carries it.

registrationToken.description: Deprecated: use initialAccessToken. The new key wins when both are set.

restrictClientMetadata.description: Accept a URL client_id only when it is pinned or its host is in clientMetadataHosts; every other one is refused before any DNS lookup. Needs at least one pin or host.

icon.description: Optional icon: a data: URI, svg/png/jpeg/webp, at most 65536 characters, SVGs sanitised.
